desc:
👋"fight in a school modded" is a free-for-all fighting game set in a school. Hang out with friends, socialize, or start rivalries and battle other players.

👍Like and favorite the game for more in game content!
Game supports: CONSOLE, PC, MOBILE

🎮Controls:
(PC): 
Left Click to attack
Hold space + WASD to weave in said direction
LeftShift to sprint

(CONSOLE):
R2 to attack
Hold L2 + move analog stick in said direction

(MOBILE): 
Fist button to attack
Hold Weave button + move in said direction

More controls in game!

v1.0.8 BETA - (7/12/2026)
